Method of Attack: File-encrypting ransomware that encrypts files on victims' computers, scrambles file names, and appends the extension .locked
Ransom note threatens deletion of a random file every six hours and loss of decryption key after four days
Indicators of Compromise: Detected by 46 out of 57 antivirus engines on VirusTotal
Ransomware note with payment deadline and threats
Impacted Systems: Victims' computers infected by the ransomware
Attack Vector: Phishing emails containing a link to the ransomware payload
